import csv,json,struct,hashlib,itertools
from pathlib import Path
from unicorn import *
from unicorn.x86_const import *
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1];b=(R/'prior/inputs/nite3w - 110.exe').read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()=='12fe5168783446275802e0e947898261b5eca6b88288f3a895fc1faa4c544481'
code=b[0x15fc0:0x15fc0+0xefbc];rows=[r for r in csv.DictReader((R/'pass35-results/listing.tsv').open(),delimiter='\t') if r['function'] in ['1010:366a','1010:2930','1010:2960']]
for r in rows:
 a=int(r['address'].split(':')[1],16);assert code[a:a+len(r['bytes'])//2].hex()==r['bytes']
(R/'pass36/column_listing.tsv').write_text('address\tbytes\tinstruction\tfunction\n'+''.join('\t'.join(r[k] for k in ['address','bytes','instruction','function'])+'\n' for r in rows))
CS=0x2000;DS=0x1048;C=CS<<4;D=DS<<4;u=Uc(UC_ARCH_X86,UC_MODE_16);u.mem_map(0,0x100000);u.mem_write(C+0x366a,code[0x366a:0x374d]);u.mem_write(C+0x2930,code[0x2930:0x29be]);src=bytes((i*37+(i>>8)*11)&255 for i in range(65536));u.mem_write(0x50000,src);palette=bytes(255-i for i in range(256));u.mem_write(D+0x8094,palette)
u.mem_write(D+0x53e2,struct.pack('<H',152));u.mem_write(D+0x53e8,struct.pack('<4H',4,155,160,80));u.mem_write(D+0x51a0,struct.pack('<H',0x7000));cases=0;stale_differences=0
for width,bottom,remap,high,column in itertools.product([128,256,304,319,320],range(81,171),[0,1],[0,1],[0,3]):
 h=width>>1;l=(320-width)>>1;t=l>>1;cy=t+(h>>1);yb=t+h-1
 for reg,v in [(UC_X86_REG_CS,CS),(UC_X86_REG_DS,DS),(UC_X86_REG_SS,DS),(UC_X86_REG_SP,0xd000),(UC_X86_REG_BP,0xe000),(UC_X86_REG_SI,0x1234),(UC_X86_REG_DI,0x5678),(UC_X86_REG_EFLAGS,2)]:u.reg_write(reg,v)
 u.mem_write(D+0x53e2,struct.pack('<H',h));u.mem_write(D+0x53e8,struct.pack('<4H',t,yb,l+h,cy))
 for entry in [0x2930,0x2960]:
  u.reg_write(UC_X86_REG_SP,0xd000);u.mem_write(D+0xd000,struct.pack('<HH',0xf000,CS));u.emu_start(C+entry,C+0xf000,count=40000);assert u.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_SP)==0xd004
 u.reg_write(UC_X86_REG_SP,0xd000)
 u.mem_write(D+0xcff7,bytes([high]));u.mem_write(0x70000,b'\xa5'*65536);u.mem_write(D+0xd000,struct.pack('<9H',0xf000,CS,0,0x5000,column,23,bottom,remap,24))
 u.emu_start(C+0x366a,C+0xf000,count=5000)
 idx=2*(bottom-cy)+1;clipped=bottom>=yb;top=t if clipped else bottom-idx;count=h if clipped else idx+1
 v=((max(idx-h,0)<<22)//idx)>>1;useclip=clipped or high!=0;offset=(column*64+((v>>16)&255 if useclip else 0))&65535;frac=(v&65535) if useclip else 0;step=(64<<16)//idx;expected=bytearray(b'\xa5'*65536)
 for j in range(count):
  color=src[offset];expected[((top&255)*320+23+320*j)&65535]=palette[color] if remap else color
  total=frac+(step&65535);frac=total&65535;offset=(offset+(step>>16)+(total>>16))&65535
 assert bytes(u.mem_read(0x70000,65536))==expected
 assert u.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_AX)==1 and u.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_SP)==0xd004 and u.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_DS)==DS and u.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_BP)==0xe000
 if high and not clipped and idx>h:stale_differences+=1
 cases+=1
out=dict(cases=cases,instruction_checks=len(rows),framebuffer_bytes_per_case=65536,stubs=[],tables='original2930 and2960 execute beforeeverycolumn, no tableinjection',stale_high_byte_cases_affecting_start=stale_differences,full_game_runtime=False,limits=['Controlled64KBlinear framebuffer, noactualWinG','Bottom81..170,width128/256/304/319/320,column0/3; notallinputs','Stackhighflagbyte supplied0/1; actualcallerstack reachability unknown','Planar3E44 notexecuted'])
(R/'pass36/column_verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n');print(out)
